Crop optionBUILT--crop + drag-rect picker exist; proved effective in the trial (sheet grey 23% → 6%).

Correction 1: "combine 3 photos into one" isn't a real technique for handheld phone shots (fusion needs aligned tripod frames). Instead: pick 3+ keepers → each becomes its own cleaned catalog image → sharpest auto-flagged primary. Your product model already supports this.

Correction 2: your 4 output samples are professional brand photos with props (mood board, not a literal scene to clone). The ₹0 path delivers their look — clean, garment-forward, soft studio light — not the props.

The solution — professional, but cheap

Three tiers. Default is ₹0. Paid paths exist but are metered exceptions, not the default.

TierWhatCost / imageVerdict
Tier 1 — self-hosted rembg (built) + SAM2 hardware removal + LaMa inpaint + crop/shine — all open-source, CPU-capable, no API key ₹0 DEFAULT closes every failure mode in this report
Tier 2 — paid fallback Photoroom API ($0.02) · Claid.ai (~₹3–10) · Pixelcut ($0.05); gpt-image-1 masked (₹1.7–16) as generative last resort ₹2–16 EXCEPTION ONLY metered via existing F-023 AI credits; trial before wiring
Tier 3 — premium upsell On-model shots: Kolors via fal.ai ($0.07 ≈ ₹5.8) or Fashn.ai — garment on a model; also managed ghost-mannequin tools (Photoroom/Kaptured/ZMO) ₹6+ FUTURE "premium listing" feature, not the default flow (V-Tone stays admin-demo only: 32 min/image)
Why segmentation over generation: background swap copies garment pixels through untouched — zero risk to embroidery. Generative models drift on fine patterns. Rule: mask or don't generate.

Decisions & honest expectations

Decided

  • SAM2 and staff instructions (both, not either/or)
  • Backdrop: retailer-choosable + brand default
  • 4 sample outputs = mood board only
  • Mobile-only, in product-add
  • Trial paid APIs before wiring one

Risks

  • SAM2 is make-or-break — validate on ~20 real photos before committing
  • ₹0 "professional" = clean flat-backdrop look, not staged scenes
  • Ghost-mannequin ceiling: approximation, not studio-perfect
  • Dockerfile Python wiring needs a Railway rebuild to go live

Won't build

  • Self-hosted diffusion (V-Tone = 32 min/image proof)
  • 3-photo pixel fusion (not a real technique)
  • Staged-scene generation in the default path
  • Snappyit (dead vendor) · Remove.bg (overpriced) · Canva API (wrong architecture)
